items.label: EXQUISITE LOOK & DURABLE MATERIAL
items.value: Our handbags are made from high-quality rattan-embroidered PU leather with exquisite edging for a smooth, soft touch. Meticulously designed, they blend fashion with sturdiness, ensuring both style and longevity

items.label: PERFECT SIZE
items.value: 11.8"*4.3"*9"(S), 13.8"*5.5"*10.3"(M). Handle height 4.7 inches. The adjustable shoulder strap extends to 22.24 inches, making it perfect for carrying or slinging over the shoulder

items.label: AMPLE ORGANIZED SPACE
items.value: A large compartment pocket, an interior zip pocket, and two slip pockets provide plenty of room to organize essentials. Comes with a practical wallet to keep your items organized and easy to carry

items.label: SUITABLE FOR VARIOUS OCCASIONS
items.value: Our LOVEVOOK bag can be used as a handbag or as a cross-body bag. The elegant high-end design is suitable for any occasion such as work, business, dating, daily life, and travel. It matches perfectly with any outfit and allows you to wear it comfortably

items.label: SMOOTH ZIPPER
items.value: The zipper closure is made of high-quality materials to ensure a smooth and reliable use experience. The top edge is inlaid with rivets, which reinforces it and adds a touch of sophistication and elegance to the overall design

items.label: PERFECT GIFT
items.value: This bag is perfect when you're not sure what to gift. Its classic and elegant colors and styles suit a variety of people and ages. Whether it's Valentine's Day, a birthday, or Mother's Day, it's ideal
